subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept `requiredClientCaps` plus a bundled Canvas `show_widget` web-chat tool as the supported direction for inline agent widgets?
rationale: The request adds durable plugin/gateway API surface and a model-authored markup sandbox boundary, so code inspection cannot substitute for maintainer product and security ownership.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path and require mechanical fixes plus explicit API/security acceptance before merge.

options.title: Redesign the seam first
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the PR until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Reject bundled widget support
options.body: Close the implementation path and route experimentation to external plugins or ClawHub until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path and require mechanical fixes plus explicit API/security acceptance before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the active implementation candidate and is the clearest current routing point for accepting or reshaping the product/API direction.
